description.value: A Starbucks Coffee location on Fraser Highway in the Fraser Valley, one of the busiest arterial corridors in the Lower Mainland. As a drive-through and walk-in café, it offers the full Starbucks espresso and food menu in a standalone building. Touring cyclists on the Fraser Valley route will find it a reliable stop for a caffeine fix and food between communities.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record is clearly a real Starbucks Coffee at 27617 Fraser Highway with tags confirming takeaway=yes and internet_access=wlan, both of which I can treat as supporting evidence. The fetched website is the generic Starbucks Canada homepage (starbucks.ca) and contains no location-specific information for this branch, so bike parking, washrooms, water refill, and other site-level amenities cannot be confirmed from it. Because the website is corporate/national rather than store-specific, contact details (phone, address) cannot be corroborated from it.
concerns: Website URL (starbucks.ca) resolves to the generic Starbucks Canada homepage; no store-locator or location-specific page was available, so phone number and address could not be corroborated from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible Starbucks Coffee on a major BC highway corridor — a straightforward inclusion as a reliable food and drink stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Corporate menu features oat milk-based drinks (Iced Brown Sugar Oat Shaken Espresso with oat beverage, Iced Mango Cream Matcha) indicating plant-based/vegetarian options
